title: Bedrock models move off the legacy proxy
summary:
Bedrock routing got a repair and a fallback; API-key authentication got less database work to do under load.

The team moved `nova-fast` and Claude 3.5 Haiku to native Bedrock routing through Portkey, addressing the proxy’s unsupported-model response for `nova-fast`.

`nova-fast` now uses Nova Micro as its primary model and falls back to Nova Lite if the primary fails, including when it hits a rate limit.

API-key usage tracking moved out of the synchronous authentication path to reduce database contention under concurrency. Non-critical tracking errors no longer produce auth logs, and request limits were adjusted while the Pollen limiter remains in place.
